relevance_note: Single neonatal case with a diagnosis of LAD-I ('Diagnosis was confirmed as LAD-I severe form'), made by flow cytometry; no ITGB2 variant is reported for her.
method_note: Hand-written by reading the paper; a short script only assembled the JSON. Field reports_individuals_with_tnfaip3_variant is read as the LAD-I/ITGB2 scope flag. No genetic testing was done (parents declined further work-up), and the paper ties no ITGB2 variant to the patient, so the variants table is empty (the only ITGB2 mention is general background in the Discussion). Both parents are included as relatives tested by flow cytometry ('normal levels noted in both parents'); sex not stated, labelled 'parent of patient' and 'parent of patient 2'. Labels of individuals in child tables carry span null because the label span is given in the individuals table. Haemoglobin 8.5 g/dl, platelets 102,000, CRP 85 mg/L and band forms 11% are printed without the authors calling them abnormal, so no anaemia, thrombocytopenia or elevated-CRP rows were made. Normal CSF recorded as 'abnormal cerebrospinal fluid values' excluded; meningitis left not reported. Positive blood culture (Acinetobacter) recorded as a feature, but sepsis left not reported because the paper does not use that word. Skin or soft tissue infection marked observed from the necrotic skin lesions plus the positive wound swab. 'No pus discharge' is recorded as pus discharge excluded in phenotypic_features and as absence of pus formation observed in the checklist. Normal immunoglobulins, CH50 and NBT are excluded from the sentence 'results of above mentioned tests were normal'. Age at last evaluation is the age at admission ('23-day-old'), the only age given for the report; vital status 'alive' rests on discharge. n_patients_reported left null because the paper reports no patient with an ITGB2 variant. Cord separation on day 10 is called normal by the authors (excluded delayed separation). No contradictions found.
